provenance.author: independent benchmark-design agent
provenance.all_capabilities: virtual fixture assumptions only; no installed mode or samplebank approval
provenance.confidence: No confidence values assigned; no probability, chord-recognition or musical-naturalness claim
provenance.case_split: eight development and four withheld; one withheld per mode

protocol.source_composition: self-created symbolic data; no acquired music or audio
protocol.model_resource_values: planning limits, not measured throughput; acquisition separately approved
protocol.evaluation: case-level hard violations, protected-ID retention, explicit omissions, octave/register changes, rests and roles; no composite music-quality score
protocol.holdout_release: Only after baseline, prompt, schema and evaluator hashes and inference settings are frozen; no private-case tuning or repair-policy revision.

input.observations: Hand-authored gates distinguish ringing arpeggio strings from two attacks of the same pitch. They are exact symbolic evidence, not audio onset estimates.
input.desired_output: Keep the defining arpeggio and its held tails; preserve the two separate attacks and actual rests. One raw acoustic performer, no drums.

diagnostics: No gate truncation to turn the arpeggio into staccato.
No merged same-pitch attacks or filled rests.

input.observations: The source arrangement has a lead, answering chord attacks and separate snare evidence. The lead leaves gaps rather than playing continuously.
input.desired_output: Two raw acoustic guitars with separate lead and answering accompaniment. Preserve the lead rests; source percussion must not become either drums or pitched guitar notes.

diagnostics: Omit the four nonessential source-snare IDs explicitly.
Distinct parts must have genuinely different IDs, pitches or attack patterns, not renamed copies.

input.observations: The repeated electric pitch has separate gates and phrase velocities 44,80,112,58. The hat pattern is separate source evidence. Beat intervals are deliberately nonuniform.
input.desired_output: Keep the repeated-note groove, short rests and supplied phrase dynamics. Hats are permitted because explicit source hits exist; do not quantize or invent sustain.

diagnostics: Preserve symbolic velocity; this does not certify sample-bank loudness.
Drum pitch42 must use hats-closed, not snare-hit.

missing_facts.description: Pitch-class evidence supports more than one harmonic reading; no functional chord label has been accepted.

input.observations: The low pedal is not a certified chord root. A suspension resolves in the lead; two harmonic alternatives remain open.
input.desired_output: Keep the observed suspension, its resolution and pedal as separate roles without declaring a recovered chord. Dreamy is a desired character, not permission to extend gates or add reverb.

diagnostics: Both alternatives must survive in resolved evidence.
The proposal language cannot certify harmonic function or effects; unchanged gates are decisive.

input.observations: A defining upper melody and a nonessential low foundation are separately identified in these synthetic notes.
input.desired_output: Solo Jazz Bass carries the recognizable upper melody in its supplied register. Do not replace it with the lowest source line; explicitly omit optional foundation events.

diagnostics: More low notes is not a success metric.

input.observations: Source foundation candidates sit above overlapping upper melody notes in their current octave. Their pitch classes are evidence; their target register is an arrangement choice.
input.desired_output: Keep the upper counterline unchanged and place the foundation strictly below every overlapping upper note. A documented one-octave-down move of the foundation is allowed; doubling or crossing is not.

diagnostics: Each source foundation needs a −12-semitone receipt, never a hidden source-pitch rewrite.
Check every overlap, including melody that enters after a foundation begins.

input.observations: Lead attacks, answering acoustic dyads and long bass foundations have different source patterns.
input.desired_output: Exactly one acoustic, one electric and one Jazz Bass. Preserve the three distinct responsibilities and complementary rests, with no duplicate instrument or doubled event stream.

diagnostics: Every pitched performer must receive source-grounded material.
Three renamed copies of the melody fail even if range checks pass.

missing_facts.description: Each paired lead candidate is a mutually exclusive estimate; neither interpretation is accepted. Preserving the defining lead requires resolving this contradiction first.

input.observations: Two contradictory lead interpretations share the same windows. Strong-looking activations do not settle which is correct; all other parts are provisional.
input.desired_output: Preserve the defining line accurately. If its contradictory identity cannot be resolved from the supplied facts, abstain rather than choose, blend, play both or claim certainty.

diagnostics: No partial plan on whole-plan abstention.
Do not hide contradiction by dropping both lead candidates and arranging only the accompaniment.
